brief:
Israeli occupation forces prevented ambulance crews from reaching a house that was struck in the Harash al-Saada neighborhood of Jenin city, according to Maan Wire. The blockade stopped rescue and medical personnel from accessing the damaged residence, halting evacuation and treatment efforts at the scene.

The obstruction occurred as emergency responders attempted to reach those inside or near the targeted building. Such incidents have been documented repeatedly across the West Bank, where Israeli military operations have restricted Palestinian medical teams from operating freely in affected areas.
title: Israeli forces block ambulances from bombed house in Jenin
